answer: Farming becomes a whisper bet on surviving 109 epochs of grading, and every lagoon settlement recomputes the ripple schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 109 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
